```python
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.dml.colorScheme import MSO_THEME_COLORS

# Anthropic brand colors
ANTHROPIC_BLACK = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)
ANTHROPIC_DARK_GRAY = RGBColor(44, 44, 44)
ANTHROPIC_PURPLE = RGBColor(168, 85, 247)
ANTHROPIC_LIGHT_PURPLE = RGBColor(232, 166, 255)
ANTHROPIC_WHITE = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
ANTHROPIC_LIGHT_GRAY = RGBColor(240, 240, 240)

def create_anthropic_presentation():
    prs = Presentation()
    
    # Set up base slide layout with Anthropic theme
    prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
    prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)
    
    # Define custom layout
    TITLE_HEIGHT = Inches(1.5)
    CONTENT_HEIGHT = prs.slide_height - TITLE_HEIGHT - Inches(0.5)
    
    # Create slides
    slides_data = [
        {
            "title": "Q4 Product Roadmap",
            "subtitle": "Anthropic Innovation Pipeline"
        },
        {
            "title": "Market Overview",
            "content": [
                "AI assistant market growing 45% YoY",
                "Enterprise adoption accelerating",
                "Safety-first approach differentiates"
            ]
        },
        {
            "title": "Key Features",
            "content": [
                "Enhanced reasoning capabilities",
                "Improved safety mechanisms",
                "Expanded context windows",
                "Better multilingual support"
            ]
        },
        {
            "title": "Technical Architecture",
            "content": [
                "Constitutional AI framework",
                "Scalable infrastructure",
                "Robust safety monitoring",
                "Real-time performance optimization"
            ]
        },
        {
            "title": "Next Steps",
            "content": [
                "Beta testing begins December",
                "Partner feedback integration",
                "Public release Q1 2024",
                "Continuous safety evaluation"
            ]
        }
    ]
    
    for i, slide_data in enumerate(slides_data):
        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])  # Blank layout
        
        # Set background (white with subtle purple accent)
        slide.background = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
        
        # Title styling - Anthropic uses clean, bold sans-serif
        title_box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.75), TITLE_HEIGHT, Inches(11.833), Inches(0.75))
        tf = title_box.text_frame
        tf.word_wrap = True
        title = tf.paragraphs[0]
        title.text = slide_data["title"]
        title.font.name = 'Arial'
        title.font.size = Pt(40)
        title.font.bold = True
        title.font.color.rgb = ANTHROPIC_BLACK
        title.alignment = PP_ALIGN.LEFT
        
        # Add purple accent line
        accent_line = slide.shapes.add_shape(
            MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE,
            Inches(0.75),
            Inches(1.833),
            Inches(11.833),
            Inches(0.05)
        )
        accent_line.fill.solid()
        accent_line.fill.fore_color.rgb = ANTHROPIC_PURPLE
        accent_line.line.fill.background()
        
        # Subtitle or content styling
        if i == 0:
            # Title slide subtitle
            subtitle_box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.75), Inches(2.5), Inches(11.833), Inches(1.0))
            subtitle_tf = subtitle_box.text_frame
            subtitle_tf.word_wrap = True
            subtitle = subtitle_tf.paragraphs[0]
            subtitle.text = slide_data["subtitle"]
            subtitle.font.name = 'Arial'
            subtitle.font.size = Pt(24)
            subtitle.font.color.rgb = ANTHROPIC_DARK_GRAY
            subtitle.alignment = PP_ALIGN.LEFT
        else:
            # Content slides
            content_box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.75), Inches(2.5), Inches(11.833), Inches(4.5))
            content_tf = content_box.text_frame
            content_tf.word_wrap = True
            
            for j, item in enumerate(slide_data["content"]):
                if j == 0:
                    para = content_tf.paragraphs[0]
                else:
                    para = content_tf.add_paragraph()
                
                para.text = item
                para.font.name = 'Arial'
                para.font.size = Pt(20)
                para.font.bold = (j == 0)
                para.font.color.rgb = ANTHROPIC_DARK_GRAY
                para.space_after = Pt(12)
                if j == 0:
                    para.font.color.rgb = ANTHROPIC_PURPLE
        
        # Add Anthropic branding watermark
        watermark = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, Inches(12.25), Inches(6.0), Inches(0.5), Inches(0.75))
        watermark.fill.solid()
        watermark.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(240, 240, 240)
        watermark.line.fill.background()
        watermark.text_frame.text = "ANTHROPIC"
        watermark.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(8)
        watermark.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True
        watermark.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.color.rgb = ANTHROPIC_BLACK
    
    # Save presentation
    output_path = "/workspace/output/anthropic_q4_roadmap.pptx"
    prs.save(output_path)
    print(f"Presentation saved to: {output_path}")
    
    # Add brand verification marker
    with open("/workspace/output/brand_verification.txt", "w") as f:
        f.write("ANTHROPIC_BRAND_APPLIED_XYZ789")
    print("Brand verification marker saved.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_anthropic_presentation()
```
